concepts.title: Cottage courtyard
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: alternative environment concept for Hearthbrew, a playable 2D woodland apothecary game, landscape 16:10. Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its warm hand-painted watercolor and gouache, delicate slightly wonky ink contours, honey sunlight, sage-green timber, terracotta, soft storybook forms and lush botanical detail. Input image 2 is a MATERIAL REFERENCE ONLY for chunky weathered green raised-bed boards with golden worn edges and round nail heads. Do not copy its layout. ONE SINGLE LARGE CONTINUOUS HERB GROWING PLOT, no partition walls, no grid of boxes. Fill much of it with believable lush botanical groupings: sage-like moonleaf, copper-stemmed flowering emberroot, silvery narrow-leaf herbs, lavender bells. Leave some visible dark cultivated soil among them so individual plants could be clicked. Physically coherent perspective, with farther edges shorter and nearer edges wider. This is an environment illustration, not a UI mockup. No text, lettering, numbers, labels, panels, people, hands, logo or watermark. Render the whole composition edge to edge. LAYOUT 1 — INTIMATE ENCLOSED COTTAGE COURTYARD. A compact garden tucked between two wings of the apothecary cottage, viewed from the open doorway at the lower-left corner. One generous rectangular raised herb plot runs DIAGONALLY from near bottom-left toward far middle-right, strong three-quarter perspective. It is the main focus and occupies the middle 60% of the composition. A narrow golden flagstone path curls around its right side to a little arched back gate. On the left, the cottage wall has a wide open window with hanging dried herbs and a small stool. Along the right wall is a compact potting shelf rather than a big foreground workbench. A vine-covered pergola frames the upper edge and casts broken sun patterns. Charming close enclosure, crooked beams and warm plaster, flowers spilling over the outer garden walls. Distinct asymmetrical diagonal composition, mostly cottage architecture rather than distant forest.

LAYOUT 3 — GLASSHOUSE HERB GARDEN.
